description.p: TitanSlicer is a powerful, free and open-source 3D printer slicer with cutting-edge features for FDM printing. It supports a wide range of printers from manufacturers including Bambu Lab, Prusa, Voron, Creality, and many more.

Key features include advanced calibration tools, adaptive layer heights, tree supports, multi-material support, and an intuitive interface for both beginners and experts. TitanSlicer also provides built-in network printing capabilities for compatible printers.
Originally forked from OrcaSlicer, Bambu Studio and PrusaSlicer, TitanSlicer builds on a strong foundation with community-driven improvements and optimizations for print quality and reliability.
See the release page for detailed changelog.
